findings.finding: The bytes passed to compile_stage and the later source_sha256 manifest are from separate source reads; no frozen before/after binding is enforced in this development branch. A source drift between these reads could label an image compiled from A as source B. Cold builder already checks its source readback.
findings.recommendation: freeze source bytes before compile, bind manifest/receipt to those bytes, and re-read all original source/compiler files before exposing fixture cache
findings.severity: development fixture provenance gap; not an observed qualification failure

findings.finding: Fixture pins hash current disk files but do not compare each image digest to its component manifest at pin publication. installed_* may return an already immutable cached mapping without rereading image bytes, so an image drift predating first fixture creation can become the recorded disk pin. The executable mapping itself remains pinned.
findings.recommendation: verify every component image payload against manifest.image_sha256 and the loaded image.image_sha256 before recording pins; then check frozen pins on every reuse
findings.severity: development fixture disk-custody gap; no executable replacement claim
